definitions.explanation: Having a timid, hesitant disposition. Describes someone who lacks assertiveness or is easily discouraged.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気弱|きよわ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{気弱|きよわ}になって⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気弱|きよわ}になって、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧になってしまう。
examples.english: When I get sick, I become faint-hearted and quickly get anxious.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a な-adjective ({気弱|きよわ}な) and in the pattern {気弱|きよわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become timid/discouraged). Contrasts with {気強|きづよ}い (strong-willed). Often describes a temporary state of feeling discouraged rather than a permanent character trait.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気弱|きよわ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a timid person)
- {気弱|きよわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become faint-hearted)
- {気弱|きよわ}な⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ (a weak-hearted remark)
